subject: Co-sell SKU + region cut — proposal for AWS / Azure / GCP listings
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Sarah Lim <sarah@aws-partner.com>, GCP Marketplace Team <gcp-marketplace@partner.io>, Azure CoSell <azure_sales@azure.com>
Cc: ops@acmecloud.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-sell SKU + region cut — proposal for AWS / Azure / GCP listings

Team / partners —

Attached is a first-pass SKU/region mapping for the marketplace listings across AWS, Azure, and GCP. High-level goals: make the initial listing set co-sell-ready for enterprise customers, minimize sku fragmentation, and pick region coverage that balances demand vs. listing maintenance.

Proposal highlights (see attachment for full matrix):
- AWS: two SKUs (Standard / Enterprise). Initial regions: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1. Rationale: AWS co-sell prioritizes us-east & eu-west for the large FTR customers; keep a narrower set to reduce listing variations.
- Azure: three SKUs (Starter, Standard, Enterprise) to match marketplace SKU granularity and allow reserved capacity offers. Initial regions: eastus, northeurope. Consider adding francecentral in Q1 if partner demand emerges.
- GCP: single bundled SKU (pay-as-you-go) with wider region coverage (us-central1, us-west1, europe-west1) — GCP partner program prefers simplified SKUs for discovery.

Tradeoffs/asks:
- Pricing: see pricing_model_v3.csv. We recommend parity pricing across clouds for the Enterprise SKU but accept Azure listing fees/tax differences.
- Co-sell readiness: Sarah / Azure team — what are the minimum metadata fields you need for co-sell qualification? We need to ensure our SKU IDs and offer types match your co-sell playbook.
- Timeline: goal to have AWS + GCP soft listings in the marketplace beta by Nov 15, Azure by Dec 1.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick sync with partner reps to confirm technical packaging and required artifacts (billing + ARM/AMI/container details).
2) Legal/procurement to confirm listing T&Cs (Marissa / Karthik).
3) Marketing to prepare co-sell collateral and solution brief for each cloud (Jonas).

Attachments: marketplace_sku_proposal_v1.xlsx, pricing_model_v3.csv

Open items are called out in the attachment. Please reply with redlines or we can take into a 30-min decision call Monday.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Head of GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Diego: +1 (415) 555-0192
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah@aws-partner.com>, GCP Marketplace Team <gcp-marketplace@partner.io>, Azure CoSell <azure_sales@azure.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell SKU + region cut — proposal for AWS / Azure / GCP listings

On Fri, Sep 18, 2026 at 9:12 AM Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Attached is a first-pass SKU/region mapping for the marketplace listings across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

Thanks Diego — nice concise start. A few quick notes from procurement/ops lens: 
- For Azure, the three-SKU approach makes sense if we can map Starter -> MS-ICP (low-touch) and Enterprise -> Reserved Instances/Offer-based. Confirm with Azure rep that adding an extra SKU won't block the co-sell pipeline.
- EU priority: even though AWS eu-west-1 is included, we should move francecentral into the Q4 'watch' list — a handful of enterprise prospects in Paris asked specifically about data locality.
- Legal: Marissa, can you flag any contract template items that would differ by cloud (billing cycles, cancellation windows, marketplace-specific passthroughs)?

If partners are good with the packaging, happy to lock AWS/GCP as the Nov timeline and stagger Azure for Dec with a limited-region launch.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Market Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lim <sarah@aws-partner.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell SKU + region cut — proposal for AWS / Azure / GCP listings

Diego / team —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few AWS-specific items to call out: 
1) Offer type — AWS prefers distinct AMI/container-based offers for Standard vs. Enterprise. Make sure the marketplace_sku_proposal has separate AMI IDs or ECR images per SKU.
2) Regions — we agree with us-east-1 and eu-west-1; recommend adding ap-southeast-2 (Sydney) only if you expect ANZ demand in the first 6 months. Adding another region increases the listing and billing reconciliation effort.
3) Co-sell metadata — see attached aws_co-sell_requirements.pdf. We need a technical contact, support SLA, and a short solution brief (<= 1 page) uploaded at time of submission.
4) Pricing — AWS fees will apply to the Standard/Enterprise offers; please use the pricing_model_v3.csv to estimate net revenue after marketplace fees.

Happy to take a 20-min call to walk the checklist.

—Sarah
Sarah Lim
Partner Development Manager, AWS Marketplace
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah@aws-partner.com>, Azure CoSell <azure_sales@azure.com>, GCP Marketplace Team <gcp-marketplace@partner.io>, ops@acmecloud.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell SKU + region cut — proposal for AWS / Azure / GCP listings

Team — thanks for the quick replies and Sarah for the checklist. Finalizing decisions based on feedback:
- AWS: Standard + Enterprise SKUs, initial regions = us-east-1, eu-west-1. Hold ap-southeast-2 for Q1 unless ANZ lead velocity picks up. Owner: Jonas to coordinate AMI/ECR packaging with Eng.
- Azure: Starter / Standard / Enterprise, initial regions = eastus, northeurope; add francecentral to watch list. Owner: Lauren to confirm SKU mapping against Azure offer types and gather co-sell metadata.
- GCP: Single bundled PAYG SKU for discovery + broader region coverage (us-central1, us-west1, europe-west1). Owner: Karthik to validate billing integration and GCP listing taxonomy.

Action items (owners & target dates):
- Jonas: prepare AMI/ECR artifacts and one-pager for AWS co-sell (due Oct 20).
- Lauren: finalize Azure SKU configs and confirm regional cadence (due Oct 27).
- Marissa/Karthik: legal & billing review for cloud-specific terms; confirm any required contract addenda (due Oct 15).
- Diego: schedule partner checklist call w/ Sarah & Azure rep for Sept 28.

I’ll open a shared Drive folder with the final artifacts and request access to the HubSpot deal (HubSpot: 67890) so Partner Ops can track co-sell motions.

If there are no objections by EOD Sep 24 I’ll consider this the decision and start move-to-listing workstreams.

Thanks —
Diego
Head of GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference
